Seminyak Canggu Ubud Uluwatu Jimbaran Nusa Dua Sanur Bukit Peninsula Nusa Penida Nusa Lembongan Questions

We provide VIP transport Bali across Seminyak, Canggu, Ubud, Uluwatu, Jimbaran, Nusa Dua, Sanur, and the Bukit Peninsula. We arrange inter-island transfers to Nusa Penida and Nusa Lembongan via landing boat. How far in advance should I book? For luxury car hire Bali, 48–72 hours is usually sufficient. For weddings, events, and Bali yacht charter, we recommend 2–3 weeks. Last-minute requests are often possible — message us on WhatsApp. What is your cancellation policy? Cancellations more than 48 hours before service receive a full refund. Cancellations within 24–48 hours incur a 50% charge. Same-day cancellations are charged in full. Yacht and landing boat charters require 72 hours’ notice. What group sizes can you accommodate? Our car fleet serves up to six guests. Minibuses accommodate 8–16, and full-size buses up to 40. For larger groups, we deploy multiple vehicles with a dedicated coordinator. Yacht capacity ranges from 6-guest cruisers to 30-guest party boats. Is there space for luggage? Yes. Our SUVs and minibuses offer generous luggage capacity, ideal for airport collections. For equipment or decorator items, supplementary vehicles are available on request. Do you provide child seats? Absolutely. Child and infant safety seats are available at no extra charge. Please specify your child’s age and weight when booking so we install the correct seat before arrival. What is the maximum yacht capacity? Our Bali yacht charter fleet ranges from 6-berth cruisers to 30-guest vessels. For larger celebrations, we arrange a flotilla.
